name: Zola Ndebele
bio:
Zola's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Johannesburg, she initially pursued art, developing a keen eye for detail and color. A chance encounter with a local racing team needing a custom paint job sparked her interest. She quickly realized the artistic precision and technical skill required in motorsport paintwork were a perfect fit for her talents. 

At Century Motorsport, Zola is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication to achieving flawless finishes. Her pragmatic mindset allows her to efficiently solve problems and adapt to the demanding pace of the industry. She prides herself on staying up-to-date with the latest paint technologies and techniques, ensuring the team's cars always look their best and maintain optimal aerodynamic performance. She is also particularly adept at designing livery that enhances sponsor visibility without compromising the car's aesthetic appeal.

physical.hairStyle: Short, natural afro, often styled with a side part
physical.description: Zola is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always listens to jazz music while working to maintain focus.
Keeps a detailed logbook of every paint job with notes on techniques and materials used.
Has a small collection of vintage racing posters in her workstation.
